rows.text: The water cycle is how water moves around the Earth. It starts when water from oceans, lakes, and rivers turns into water vapor and rises into the air. This is called evaporation. The water vapor cools and turns back into liquid, forming clouds through condensation. When the clouds get heavy, the water falls back to the ground as precipitation, like rain or snow. Then, the water collects in bodies of water again, and the cycle starts over. This process keeps Earth's water moving and available for living things.

rows.text: Vaccines work by teaching your immune system how to recognize and fight off specific germs, like viruses or bacteria. They contain a small, harmless piece of the germ, such as a protein or sugar, or a weakened or dead version of the germ itself. When you get a vaccine, your body sees this piece as a threat and starts making antibodies to fight it. These antibodies stay in your body, so if you're ever exposed to the real germ, your immune system can quickly recognize and destroy it, preventing you from getting sick.

This helps regulate your body's internal clock, making it easier to fall asleep and wake up feeling refreshed. Consistent sleep schedules improve sleep quality and can lead to better overall health. Try setting a bedtime routine, like reading or meditating, to signal your body that it's time to wind down. Avoid screens and caffeine close to bedtime, as they can disrupt your sleep. Sticking to a regular sleep schedule, even on weekends, supports a healthy sleep pattern.

rows.text: The tallest mountain in Africa is Mount Kilimanjaro. It is located in Tanzania, near the border with Kenya. Standing at about five thousand nine hundred and five meters, it is a dormant stratovolcano. Mount Kilimanjaro is a popular destination for hikers and climbers, though the climb can be challenging due to the high altitude. The mountain is also a significant cultural and natural landmark, attracting many visitors each year. Its peak, Uhuru Peak, offers stunning views of the surrounding landscape.

rows.text: Copper is used in electrical wiring because it conducts electricity very well. It is also used in plumbing for pipes because it is resistant to corrosion. Copper is a good conductor of heat, making it useful for cookware. It is also durable and long-lasting, which is why it is often used in coins and jewelry. Copper is a good material for these uses because it is both strong and versatile.
